packageRules.description: Python stays below 3.15. PyYAML 6.0.3, the latest release, ships no cp315 wheel (yaml/pyyaml#981 and #994, open on 2026-11-01), and CI and the Dockerfiles install wheels only (pip --only-binary :all: --require-hashes), so every 3.15 bump fails backend-test. Remove this rule once PyYAML publishes cp315 wheels.
